data.name: Bhishma
data.gender_notes: Bhishma is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhishma was a great warrior and teacher in Hindu mythology. The name Bhishma is derived from the Sanskrit word bhi, meaning 'fear', and shma, meaning 'devoted to'. Bhishma was devoted to the Vedas and thus was named Bhishma. He was known for his unwavering devotion to duty and dharma. The name Bhishma carries the meaning “Dedicated to Vedas” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhishma usually hope their child will grow to embody dedicated to vedas and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bhishma belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dedicated to Vedas.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhishma total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
